summary: Hand a bounded task to a local model that drives the sidecar's own Observe verbs through the governed seam, returning a distilled answer plus the full trail. Offloads grunt work from the calling agent.

task.description: what the local model should find out

allow.description: tool allowlist (default: Observe-only repo_search/glob/read_file/file_tree/diff; `delegate` is never allowed)

evidence.description: attach the answer + trail to the Bag of Evidence

apply.description: run it (else preview the task, model, allowlist and budget)

allow_apply.description: deliberately permit non-Observe (write/exec) tools in the allowlist; refused otherwise

steps.description: the trail: each tool call, args, ok, and a capped observation
